summary: US equities fell on Nov 13, led by semiconductors: S&P 500 -0.7% and Nasdaq 100 -1.7% by midday as AMD dropped 10.5% and Nvidia fell 3.3% ahead of its Nov 17 earnings, its first without Jensen Huang as CEO. Treasury yields reportedly hit 5% and the Dollar Index a 19-month high, coinciding with a crypto selloff that took Bitcoin below $70,000 and ether below $2,000. Brent traded near $98.45; EIA data showed a 4.657M bbl US crude build for the week ended Nov 6. Gold was little changed near $3,880. Next week's focus: US October retail sales (Tue), Nvidia earnings, RBA minutes, UK jobs data and the German ZEW survey.
